{{CharInfobox |color=666666 |corecolor=CCCCCC |bordercolor=CC0000 |name= Professor Sebastian |jname=シラヌイ博士 |tmname=Dr. Shiranui |text=white |image=Professor Sebastian.png |size=250px |caption=Professor Sebastian |gender=Male |region=[[Johto]] |relatives=Unknown |team=yes |teamname=[[Team Rocket]] |teamrank=[[Team Rocket scientist|Scientist]] |brain=no |anime=yes |epnum=The Legend of Thunder! |epname=The Legend of Thunder! |enva=[[Eric Stuart]] |java=Hidetoshi Nakamura }} '''Professor Sebastian''' (Japanese: '''シラヌイ博士''' ''Dr. Shiranui'') is a recurring character in the [[Pokémon animated series]]. He is a [[Team Rocket scientist]]. ==History== ===''[[The Legend of Thunder!]]''=== Professor Sebastian gave [[Attila]] and [[Hun]] the Miracle Crystal weapon, which could attract, absorb and reflect electricity, to aid them in capturing {{OBP|Raikou|The Legend of Thunder!}}. ==={{aniseries|GS}}=== Professor Sebastian was the mastermind behind [[Team Rocket]]'s scheme, [[Project R]]. He had designed the [[Evolution]]-Inducement Wave which causes one of [[Lake of Rage]] {{p|Magikarp}} to evolve into a {{TP|Lance|Red Gyarados|Gyarados}}. He succeeded in capturing the rare specimen for further study in ''[[EP235|Talkin' 'Bout an Evolution]]''. Professor Sebastian later transported the Red Gyarados to a secret meeting point near [[Mahogany Town]] in ''[[EP236|Rage of Innocence]]''. While he left aboard a helicopter without any disruptions, Project R was later foiled. His main support, {{OBP|Tyson|Team Rocket}}, was intercepted by {{an|Lance}} and arrested by [[Officer Jenny]]. The Red Gyarados was later captured by Lance. ==={{aniseries|RS}}=== During the opening sequence of ''[[M09|Pokémon Ranger and the Temple of the Sea]]'', Professor Sebastian was seen alongside Attila and Hun while admiring their latest catch, a {{p|Rayquaza}}. ==Character== Professor Sebastian is a calculated individual who often speaks in a steady even tone. He is particularly cold towards Pokémon, only valuing them as tools and specimens of study and believing that they should serve humanity. He invests his knowledge into creating weaponry and operates alongside high-ranking individuals like [[Attila]] and [[Hun]] to achieve his utilitarian ideal. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color=666666|bordercolor=CC0000 |ja=中村秀利 ''Hidetoshi Nakamura'' |en=[[Eric Stuart]] |it=Claudio Ridolfo ([[EP235]]-[[EP236]])
